summary: Iter49 — Footer management, pages CMS, cs_qr_image upload, Banners site-config section. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (GET /api/footer default 3 cols; GET /api/settings has cs_qr_image; admin PUT /api/admin/footer 4 cols incl 測試欄 + hot:true, public /footer matches, POST reset restores 3 cols; GET /api/admin/articles/pages returns 10 rows without content_html; POST /api/admin/articles/pages creates test-page-x (page:true, content preserved on public /api/articles/{id}), duplicate -> 409, PUT without content_html preserves html and sets active:false, DELETE cleanup -> public GET 404; PUT /api/admin/settings {cs_qr_image: data:image/png} returns /api/img/... URL that is 200, and clearing to '' resets). Frontend admin UI (admin@gogo589.com + TOTP 2FAI...): 運營管理 sidebar shows admin-nav-banners & admin-nav-footer; FooterAdmin loads 3 cols, editing footer-link-label-0-0 公司介紹→公司簡介 + footer-links-save shows 已儲存 toast, persists after reload, restored. footer-pages-table has 10 rows; footer-page-edit-faq opens editor with title=常見問題; footer-page-add → slug ui-test-page title UI測試頁 saved, row appears, toggle active works, delete removes it. /admin?s=banners shows 5 siteconfig tabs (top_promo/hero/promo_banners/detail_banners/announcement) and banners-goto-home navigates to home-decoration (homelayout-save visible). /admin?s=siteconfig → siteconfig-tab-whatsapp → upload tiny PNG via settings-qr-img, settings-save returns cs_qr_image=/api/img/.../qr.png; front-end Footer renders with that src; after clearing via 清除 button + save, cs_qr_image becomes '' and footer-qr-image disappears (falls back to generated QR). GET /api/articles/faq publicly returns 200 with content.
critical_code_review_comments: cms_api.py admin_update_page uses to_traditional() on content_html; if admin saves content with mixed Simp/Trad intentionally (e.g. '简体'), it will be force-converted. Acceptable for a Traditional-first site but note.

cms_api.py POST /admin/articles/pages generates slug by stripping non [a-z0-9-]; passing an all-non-ascii id falls back to new_id() (nanoid). UI's footer-page-slug Input is free-text so this is defensive, but UX could surface the normalized slug before save.
server.py put_settings allowlists keys to DEFAULT_SETTINGS so unknown keys silently drop — fine, but a 400 on unknown key would help API clients.
FooterAdmin save shows 已儲存 toast but no success key response check beyond r.data; acceptable.
Footer.jsx fetches /api/footer on mount; a very brief flash of empty cols is possible before data loads — consider SWR cache or SSR of first paint if needed.
